author: Khan Academy
description:
In this roundtable discussion, Sal Khan, Founder of Khan Academy, sits down with educational leaders from across California to discuss the challenges of bringing new technology and AI into the classroom.

Christy Chen, Educational Technology Coordinator for West Contra Costa USD, highlights a critical gap in the system: while professional development (PD) is often prioritized for teachers, there is "zero" PD specifically for school administrators. She argues that for a school to truly innovate, its principal must also be an early adopter.
title: Why School Leaders Are the Key to AI & Tech Innovation | Sal Khan & District Leaders

author: Khan Academy
description:
Can technology give teachers the permission they need to innovate? In this segment of the Khan Academy Reimagined for Districts roundtable, district leaders discuss the systemic pressure to prioritize test scores over creative, integrated learning.

Amy Thomas, Director of Innovation Design & Learning at Alisal Union School District, explores how a focus on high-stakes testing creates a siloed approach to education. She emphasizes that to truly adopt new technology, we must first empower teachers to break free from rigid, antiquated instruction models.
title: Dismantling the “Teach to the Test” Mindset | Sal Khan & CA District Leaders

author: Khan Academy
description:
Are we treating AI as just another app, or are we ready for a total digital transformation? In this snippet from the Khan Academy Reimagined for Districts roundtable, educational leaders discuss the unique potential of AI to revolutionize school districts from the top down.

Gerardo Martinez, Ed Tech Coordinator for Westminster SD, argues that we are at a crossroads. Unlike past technology that focused on simple substitution, AI offers a "partnership" that can help solve problems at every level, from district administration to individual student learning.
title: AI in the Classroom: From Tool to Collaborative Partner | Sal Khan & District Leaders

author: Khan Academy
description:
In this video from the Khan Academy Reimagined for Districts roundtable, Sal Khan joins IT and EdTech leaders from across California to tackle the systemic barriers preventing a true shift in student learning.

Mike Lawrence, Director of IT at ABC USD, argues for a shift in the policy environment. He challenges the "straw man" argument that EdTech is designed to replace teachers and calls for a legislative push to break the "addiction" to traditional assessments that fail to measure real-world competence.
title: Is Education Policy Killing Innovation? Sal Khan & CA School Leaders
